basic_details.job_title: BEL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 23 Field Operation Engineer, Project Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), a Navaratna Company under the Ministry of Defence, needs 23 engineers on a temporary contract of two years for the NexGen UP112 project in Uttar Pradesh: 8 Senior Field Operation Engineers (Rs. 90,000 a month), 7 Field Operation Engineers (Rs. 70,000 a month) and 8 Project Engineer-I (Rs. 50,000 a month). Candidates need a B.E/B.Tech/BSc Engg, MCA or MSc in the listed disciplines with 2 to 8 years of experience. Online registration on bel-india.in opens on 24 November 2026, and the last date is 9 December 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through SBI Collect (online mode), using the payment link in the notice or on the BEL website: select PSU-Public Sector Undertaking, Bharat Electronics Ltd, then the payment category for the post (Senior Field Operation Engineer (Sr FOE)- HLS&SCB SBU, Field Operation Engineer (FOE)- HLS&SCB SBU or Project Engineer-I- HLS&SCB SBU). A separate payment must be made for each post applied for. The "SBI Collect reference No." generated after payment must be entered in the application form. The same mobile number and email ID must be used in SBI Collect as in the online application form. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

how_to_apply: Open the relevant link provided against the advertisement on the BEL official website, https://bel-india.in, between 24 November and 9 December 2026.
Pay the application fee through SBI Collect (unless exempted) and note the SBI Collect reference No.
Fill in the necessary fields in the online format, entering all information correctly, as no changes are permitted after submission.
Attach the documents listed below and click Submit; the filled application form is sent to your registered mail ID.

Carry the printout with 2 recent passport size colour photographs and the relevant documents to the selection centre on the day of selections, which will be intimated later on your registered mail ID.
Registrations in any other format, hardcopy or any other mode will not be considered. Certificate formats are at www.bel-india.in/careers/.
SSLC/SSC/ISC/10th Standard marks card (as proof of date of birth).
All certificates from Matriculation/Class X onwards in support of educational qualifications.
B.E/B.Tech/BSc Engg (4 years)/MCA/MSc degree certificate, with the CGPA/credits conversion formula issued by the university where applicable.
All semester marks sheets or final consolidated marks sheet.

Caste/Community/Disability/Income certificate in the prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS respectively; OBC (NCL) certificate issued on or after 01.11.2025; EWS Income & Asset certificate for 2026-27 or the present financial year.

Post-qualification experience certificates from previous to current employer, with joining/appointment and relieving letters; where the current experience certificate is not available, the joining/appointment letter, first and latest pay slip and employee ID proof.
No Objection Certificate, for candidates working in PSUs/Govt. organizations, at the time of application or interview.
Copy of the application fee payment receipt (SBI receipt).
A document in a language other than Hindi or English must be uploaded with a transcript attested by a gazetted officer or notary.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The 23 vacancies are spread over three posts and nine roles. The notice says the number of vacancies may be increased or decreased based on the actual requirement at the discretion of the Management. Reservation is given for each post as a whole, not for each role: Reservation for Persons with Disability (PwBD) and concession or relaxation for reserved categories will be as per Government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice requires a full time B.Tech/BE/BSc Engg (4 Years), MCA or MSc from a recognized university, obtained from an AICTE/UGC approved college/Institute or recognized University. Only Indian nationals need apply. Each role's qualification is: The listed disciplines are Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication / Computer Science, Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology, Information Science and Electrical & Electronics Engineering. For IT Support staff and IT Helpdesk Staff, the list also includes Mech. Teaching, academic or research work will not be considered as relevant post-qualification industrial experience. Experience in banking and financial institutions, non-profit organizations and internship placements that are part of the academic curriculum will not be considered as experience. The skills each role needs are listed with its duties below. These limits are for General and EWS candidates. The upper age limit is relaxed as follows: See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is all-inclusive and consolidated, with an increase of Rs.5000/- for every year of extension of contract. The yearly amount is paid towards medical insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance etc. The contract is initially for Two (2) Years from the date of joining and may be extended up to a maximum of two more years (maximum tenure of 4 years including the initial period), depending on the requirement of the project and the candidate's performance. Selected Sr FOE and FOE candidates must obtain Medical Insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Cover Insurance of Rs. 10 lakhs per annum and submit it at the time of joining. Selected Project Engineers must obtain Medical Insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Cover Insurance of Rs. 5 lakhs per annum and submit it at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: BEL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To provide highly specialized technical expertise towards administration of databases. Installation of database, creation of schemas, table spaces, defining users, user profiles, memory utilization, caching etc. Monitoring and maintenance of databases, installation of database software patches, monitoring of backups, standardization and implementation of databases. Improving management of production and test environments and resolving problems with application databases. Day-to-day tasks such as allocating volumes, managing zones, LUN etc., fabric security, utilization analysis, performance tuning and system updates or fixes. Skills asked for: good understanding of the underlying operating system; knowledge of physical database design; database and operating system performance tuning and monitoring; proficiency with MS SQL, Oracle Database and Hadoop; programming with experience in handling standby databases preferred. Maintaining the optimum performance of the Emergency Response system. Handling System Administration challenges for complex and large-scale systems. Monitoring system activities, utilization and resources, capacity control, performance tuning, system updates or fixes, adding or deleting users and generating reports. Ensuring systems security through usage policies, backup and restore, etc. Granting access and permission to various users. Skills asked for: sys admin of RDMB data (MS-SQL, Oracle etc.), sysadmin of windows-2008/2012 etc. servers, programming in .NET, SQL, PL/SQL, etc. Installation, setup or configuration, troubleshooting, tuning, diagnostics and maintenance of networking and related equipment. Coordinating with other vendors or agencies to resolve network issues. Managing deployment and maintenance of IT Security infrastructure and compliance with IT security policy directives and regulations of GoUP. Monitoring content filtering and blocking, virus protection and vulnerability protection tools. Escalating security breaches and installing patches for threats related to OEM products. Maintaining an updated knowledge base of published security vulnerabilities and virus threats. Skills asked for: Routing and Switching devices and technologies like ATM, Frame Relay, MPLS, Wireless, Broadband and Protocol Analysis Tools; intermediate skills in Anti-virus, Firewalls, 2 & 3 factor Authentication, IDS, IPS, Content Filtering, Encryption, VPN and Threat Management; familiarity with Information Security Audit parameters. Working closely with analysts, solution architects, database designers and UP112 to customize the ER applications. Gathering business requirements and developing specifications for the ER applications. Producing detailed specifications and writing program code. Unit-testing software in controlled, real situations before going live. Preparing training manuals and assisting System administrators in maintaining the systems. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for Sr FOE, FOE and Project Engineers is through a written test followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates. All candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be called for the written test. From those who pass, a category-wise list is drawn and normally candidates in the ratio of 1:10 in each category are called for the interview; where a category has fewer candidates, all who passed the written test are called. The assessment weightage is 85% for the written test and 15% for the interview. Candidates are considered for final selection only if they score more than the qualifying marks in the personal interview. Shortlists for the written test and interview and the final selections will be notified on the BEL website, and call letters will be sent by email only.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies: 8 Senior Field Operation Engineers, 7 Field Operation Engineers and 8 Project Engineer-I, all for the NexGen UP112 project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration opens on 24 November 2026, and the last date for online registration and submission of the application is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for these BEL posts?
faq.answer: A full time B.E/B.Tech/BSc Engg (4 years) in the listed electronics, computer, IT or electrical disciplines is needed; MCA is also accepted for most Sr FOE roles and System Admin, MSc (Computer Science/Information Technology) for Sr Application Developer, and Mech for IT Support staff and IT Helpdesk Staff.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01.11.2026, the upper age limit is 45 years for Sr FOE, 40 years for FOE and 32 years for Project Engineer-I (General and EWS). OBC (NCL) get 3 years, SC/ST 5 years and PwBD 10 years of relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a BEL Field Operation Engineer and Project Engineer-I?
faq.answer: The first-year consolidated pay is Rs. 90,000 per month for Sr FOE, Rs. 70,000 for FOE and Rs. 50,000 for Project Engineer-I, with an increase of Rs. 5,000 for every year of extension.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.450/- + 18% GST for Sr FOE and FOE and Rs.400/- + 18% GST for Project Engineer-I, paid through SBI Collect. PwBD, SC and ST candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection done?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates, with 85% weightage for the written test and 15% for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are temporary contract posts for an initial period of two years, which may be extended by up to two more years, to a maximum tenure of 4 years.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for more than one post, but a separate fee payment must be made for each post.

faq.question: Q10. Do allowances come on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, a consolidated ₹20,000 per year (Sr FOE and FOE) or ₹12,000 per year (Project Engineer-I) is paid towards medical insurance premium, attire, stitching and footwear allowance.
